call_points.text: A single large fire loss cost ₹12.4 Cr on the net account in the quarter.
No provision taken for the Supreme Court housewife-claim ruling; a review petition is pending.
Ind AS implementation deferred to April 1, 2027 under IRDAI forbearance; no impact estimate yet.
Industry CAT losses estimated at ₹3,000-4,000 Cr; pricing correction likely only at next reinsurance renewal.
Health degrowth reflects pricing corrections in the PSU bank group platform and migration to retail.
Combined ratio for the year was 115.2%, impacted by motor third-party reserve augmentation and higher motor OD claims.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,443.66 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹687.14 Cr.
Cholamandalam Financial Holdings released its Q4FY26 investor presentation highlighting strong growth in consolidated revenue and PAT.
In May 2026, Cholamandalam Financial Holdings announced the appointment of Shyam Shankar as CFO and Manager effective June 15, 2026, succeeding N Ganesh.
Cholamandalam Financial Holdings held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 8, 2026, detailing insurance performance and leadership changes.
On 14 August 2026 Chola MS told analysts Q1FY27 combined ratio was 120.4% with motor OD loss ratio above 80%, targeting below 80% over time.
